# **node镜像**



```
npm config get registry
```





返回



```
https://registry.npmmirror.com/
```





如果不是这个那么设置镜像



```
npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
```


## **安装安卓模拟器**

https://www.ldmnq.com/



## **创建项目**

### **1、通过命令创建**



```
npx degit dcloudio/uni-preset-vue#vite easyjob-app
```







### **2、直接下载空项目**

https://www.123pan.com/s/11qA-bXMX.html





### **3、增加几个配置**

​            1、     忽略版本 manifest.json



```
        "compatible": {
            "ignoreVersion": true
        },
```







​            2、     页面回弹效果

pages.json



```
"app-plus": {
			"bounce": "none"
}
```





### **4、安装依赖**





```
npm install md5@^2.3.0 sass@^1.63.6 sass-loader@^13.3.2  --save

npm install pinia@2.0.36 --legacy-peer-deps
```
